terra.problem: The first moment describes Xerxes’ feast in Susa, not an event in India. Esther 1:1 names India as a boundary of his kingdom.

The second moment says Mordecai’s letters reached India, but Esther 8:9–14 describes their writing and dispatch, not their arrival. It also says each province received the letter in its own script and language; the passage says each province had its own script and each people its own language.
